ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, authorised signatories and registered agents against: the UN Security Council Consolidated List; the OFAC/UBO sanctions list; the EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists; and the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit’s domestic watchlist. PEPs must undergo enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval. Screening is carried out immediately prior to incorporation, refreshed annually, and records are retained for at least five years under the MLTPA.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies and Corporate Business Registry (Belize) Online Name Clearance Service, accessible through the official portal (registry.belize.gov.bz) or through fully licensed registered agents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in English using the basic Roman alphabet. No transliteration from non-Roman scripts is accepted. The IBC name must include a legal element such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', 'Corporation', or the expression 'International Business Company' or its abbreviation, consistent with Section 30 of the IBCOA.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant’s registered agent may file a written appeal with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection notification. If the name was refused because of a restricted token, the applicant must obtain prior written consent from the relevant supervisory authority (e.g., Belize Central Bank for banking/insurance terms) and resubmit. Name reservations are not extendable; if the initial 30-day reservation expires, a new application with a new fee must be filed no later than 5 business days before the expiry date. Where the name is confusingly similar to an existing registration, the applicant may provide a legal memorandum and trademark search results to support administrative appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only where the registered office is the physical address of a licensed Belize registered agent. A virtual office for correspondence is accepted, but a physical registered agent address in Belize must be maintained. No local business premises are required for the matcha powder distribution business, and remote management from abroad is permitted.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 of the Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020 (as amended), especially sections 3 (incorporation), 6 (contents of memorandum), 9 (articles), 10 (registered office and registered agent) and 11 (share capital).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, International Business Companies Section, Belize City, Belize.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Authorized capital is chosen freely (typically US$50,000); no escrow account or advance paid-in capital deposit is required for the Belize IBC.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed are ratified and the subscriber’s subscription for 5,000 ordinary shares at US$1.00 each is accepted, such shares paid in full from the subscriber’s consideration. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office at the address stated in the Memorandum is adopted and Belize Corporate Services Ltd. is approved as Registered Agent. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Director A] and [Director B] are elected directors and [Secretary] is elected Secretary, each empowered to execute statutory filings, arrange banking, and complete formation steps. ADOPTED on [Date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize (through a licensed Belize registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to submit a name availability request to the Registry, proposing the exact IBC name and up to two alternate names. The Registry will perform an electronic conflict search and reserve an approved name for the prescribed statutory period, usually 90 days. The name must end with an approved suffix such as 'Limited' or 'Corporation'.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and up to two alternatives
Memorandum of Association draft with subscriber names
Identification of proposed directors, shareholders, registered office and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as confusingly similar or contrary to public policy, re-submit revised alternatives within the reservation period; no substantive additional government fee is charged for a re-filing of the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Belize registered agent and notary public or other authorized Belize officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory form, indicating the principal purpose of international cross-border wholesale trading in food and beverage products (ISIC 4631), including organic matcha powder. The governing documents must specify authorized capital, registered office address, registered agent, and initial directors. Execute the documents in the presence of a notary public or other authorized officer, with identity verification for all foreign subscribers and directors.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association in final form
Consent to act as director for each proposed director
Consent of the proposed registered agent
Copy of passport and proof of residential address for each subscriber and director
Registered office address confirmation from the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry marks the documents as defective because of notarization or authentication gaps, the documents may be re-executed and re-delivered within 48 hours; no new incorporation number is required for such procedural correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Government Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the fully executed and notarized memorandum and articles, together with the completed incorporation application forms, declarations, and the official state filing fee of US$100. Submission is made through the licensed registered agent, either physically at the Registry counter or through the approved electronic filing portal. Retain the stamped acknowledgment and payment receipt.
required_dossiers: Completed incorporation application form (prescribed land registry form)
Executed and notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent declaration and consent
Government filing fee receipt or bank transfer confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for missing signatures, incomplete schedules, or insufficient fee, the registered agent has 10 business days to cure the defect; revocation is avoided by prompt response and, where necessary, a corrected filing with explanatory submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Registered Office Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval of the filing, the Registry will issue the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent will collect the Certificate and the certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles, confirm the registered office and agent details, and, in accordance with the IBC Act, notify any required authority. The company’s existence and limited liability status become effective as of the date stated on the Certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent confirmation of office address
Incorporation fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical or clerical errors, submit a formal correction request with a certified copy of the Certificate within 30 days; the Registry will issue an amended certificate without altering the original incorporation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Formation Corporate Governance and Bank File Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the IBC (through corporate secretary and registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written resolution to ratify the constitution, approve the share allotment, elect officers, adopt the corporate seal, and authorize the opening of a bank account. Issue share certificates to the subscribers, maintain the register of directors, members, and officers, and complete any beneficial ownership filings as required by the Belize registered agent under local compliance regulations.
required_dossiers: First board resolution (or written consent) approving share subscription and officer appointments
Share certificates for issued shares
Register of directors, members, and officers
Minutes of first board meeting, where applicable
Corporate banking opening package (including passport copies, proof of address, and corporate references)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a board resolution is found defective or incomplete, adopt a corrective written resolution ratifying all prior acts of the directors and officers, and re-issue the relevant corporate records to reflect the corrected decision.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — no domestic industrial or manufacturing license; the Belize IBC is an offshore trading vehicle engaged exclusively in cross-border wholesale distribution of organic matcha powder.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required for cross-border wholesale trading; no local trade license is obtainable or required for an IBC acting outside Belize's domestic market.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment (DOE), Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no physical installation, construction, or industrial processing activity; no EIA report or environmental clearance is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the current offshore trading model. If the company later maintains a warehouse or storage facility in Belize, operations will be subject to the Environmental Protection Act and the applicable effluent, solid waste, and storage handling standards of the DOE and the Belize Solid Waste Management Authority.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for a pure offshore trading company. If physical premises in Belize are later established, a fire safety certificate under the National Fire Service Act, structural load inspections under the Building Code, and occupational safety clearances from the Labour Department would become mandatory before operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize (unified administration of income tax and General Sales Tax); official e-filing portal: https://taxservice.gov.bz. The Belize Customs and Excise Department separately administers customs duties, import GST collection, and export controls.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders must appoint a licensed registered agent in Belize to incorporate the International Business Company (IBC) under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270) and to obtain a Tax Information Number (TIN). Step 1: the registered agent files incorporation documents with the Belize Companies Registry, and the International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) issues the IBC annual licence. Step 2: obtain certificate of incorporation, registered office certificate, and director/shareholder registers. Step 3: submit TIN application to the Belize Tax Service with the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, registered agent confirmation, and passport copies of directors and shareholders; processing is typically 5 to 15 business days. Step 4: a TIN is required only if the IBC acquires a Belize tax nexus, namely local payroll, Belize-sourced supplies, ownership of Belize real property, or importation of goods into Belize. A pure offshore procurement and trading IBC operating exclusively outside Belize requires no TIN and files no annual tax return. Step 5: if the IBC imports organic matcha into Belize for storage, warehousing or local handling prior to re-export, it must register for GST and obtain a TIN; a licensed customs broker must be appointed for import clearance. Pure foreign holding companies without a Belize branch or permanent establishment do not obtain a TIN in respect of the IBC's offshore trading income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone. An IBC is statutorily exempt for 50 years from incorporation from all Belize national taxes on income arising outside Belize: income tax, capital gains tax (none levied), stamp duty on offshore instruments, exchange control, and GST on offshore supplies. Exemption is conditional on deriving income wholly outside Belize, not trading with Belize residents, not carrying on business in Belize with a trading licence, and not owning Belize real property except, with permission, premises necessary for its own operations. Any Belize-source income or local trading activity breaches the exempt status and subjects the IBC to income tax as a domestic company.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Belize does not operate check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections. Available elections: (1) voluntary GST registration below the BZD 100,000 threshold, which allows the IBC to recover input GST on imports and local costs; (2) an election to convert an IBC into a domestic company under the Companies Act (Cap. 250), terminating the offshore exemption and triggering ordinary Belize income tax and exchange control; (3) an economic substance notice under the Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2019 declaring tax residence in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction outside the EU non-cooperative list, displacing Belize's economic substance requirements for the distribution and service centre relevant activity; and (4) redomiciliation or continuation out of Belize, terminating the Belize tax nexus on completion.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Sales Tax (GST) — destination-based consumption tax under the General Sales Tax Act, Cap. 292, with a full input-credit mechanism analogous to VAT
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 100,000 in annual taxable supplies; a person making taxable supplies exceeding BZD 100,000 in any 12-month period must register with the Belize Tax Service. Voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold. Importation of goods into Belize attracts GST at importation regardless of turnover; the importer must hold a TIN and appoint a licensed customs broker. There is no separate registration scheme for non-resident digital or offshore suppliers where the supply occurs outside Belize.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None currently mandated. Belize does not impose real-time fiscal clearance, government digital stamping, continuous transaction controls, or API-based invoice authorisation. The Belize Tax Service operates an electronic filing and payment portal for GST returns and TIN administration; taxpayers must file returns electronically where required and retain GST-compliant invoices, customs entries, and supporting export documentation in paper or electronic form for audit. Invoicing must satisfy the substantive requirements of the GST Act, but no pre-clearance by the tax authority is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods, including wholesale matcha powder, are zero-rated under the GST Act where the supplier is registered, the goods are physically exported from Belize, and documentary proof of export is retained. For a Belize IBC, zero-rating is relevant only where matcha is imported into Belize and subsequently re-exported; where matcha is drop-shipped directly from Japan or another origin to the IBC's overseas customer, the supply occurs wholly outside Belize and is outside the GST net, so no Belize GST arises and no export zero-rating claim is required. Input GST paid in Belize, including GST on importation of the matcha, is creditable against output GST and refundable through the periodic GST return when attributable to zero-rated exports. The claim must be evidenced by export entry, transport documents, and foreign-currency payment proof.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Entry) as stamped by the Belize Customs and Excise Department
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export from Belize to the foreign buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT bank credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds from the foreign buyer in foreign currency
Commercial invoice and packing list with zero-rated export notation and the IBC's GST registration number
Import Entry and customs goods receipt evidencing prior importation into Belize and the GST paid at importation for goods subsequently re-exported
Certificate of Origin where preferential tariff treatment is claimed at the destination market
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Belize Tax Service may retrospectively reassess zero-rated export claims within the statutory assessment period and claw back refunded input credits with interest where export documentation is incomplete, false, or not contemporaneous. The GST Act imposes a penalty of up to 100% of the tax evaded on fraudulent zero-rating or refund claims, plus statutory interest; on conviction, fines of up to BZD 25,000 and imprisonment of up to five years may be imposed. The Customs Act separately penalises false export declarations with fines, forfeiture of the goods, and potential disqualification of the exporter. Deliberate misdeclaration may trigger exchange-of-information procedures and administrative deregistration. Although Belize IBCs are exempt from the Exchange Control Act repatriation regime, the 180-day foreign-currency receipt benchmark is applied as a prudential substantiation standard; failure to evidence timely receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency significantly increases audit adjustment risk and the likelihood of retrospective zero-rating clawback.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (Exchange Control Department), acting under the Exchange Control Act, Chapter 36 of the Laws of Belize.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belizean dollar (BZD) has been pegged to the US dollar (USD) at BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00 since 1976, with full current-account convertibility for trade transactions. Capital-account movements by residents require prior Exchange Control approval through an authorized dealer. International Business Companies (IBCs) are statutorily deemed non-resident under s.61 of the International Business Companies Act (Chapter 270) and are therefore exempt from the Exchange Control Act; they may hold USD and multi-currency accounts without restriction and remit profits, dividends, and capital abroad free of Belizean taxation and without Central Bank conversion approval. Practical impediments are limited to bank-level compliance checks and mandatory Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) reporting of transactions at or above statutory thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must collect payment within six months of shipment and surrender all foreign currency proceeds to an authorized dealer unless a foreign-currency retention account is expressly approved by the Central Bank of Belize. This regime does not apply to IBCs: an IBC's export receipts are exempt from surrender and mandatory conversion, and may be retained in any currency in its foreign-currency accounts. Inbound payments should be routed via SWIFT MT103 with clear trade purpose codes; all cash and wire movements at or above BZD 10,000 (or USD 5,000 where applicable under the Money Laundering (Prevention) Act) are reported to the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium for payables and auxiliary receivables; Low for primary clearing and FX conversion. Legal constraints: a foreign Electronic Money Institution (EMI) not licensed under the Banks and Financial Institutions Act (Chapter 316) cannot take deposits or operate as an authorized dealer in Belize; e-money issuance and deposit-taking require a banking or financial institution license. Foreign EMIs (e.g., UK FCA-regulated or EU-licensed) may be used as a supplementary payment corridor for supplier disbursements and customer collections, but all underlying FX conversion and cross-border settlements must ultimately traverse a licensed Belize commercial bank or a prime international correspondent bank. Correspondent EMI services (Airwallex, Currencycloud, M-DAQ) can be tethered to the IBC's USD account at Atlantic Bank or Belize Bank to optimize conversion spreads.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is permitted for IBCs by most tier-1 Belize banks, subject to Enhanced Due Diligence: certified true copies of passports, a banker's reference from the applicant's existing bank, a corporate registry extract, certificate of incumbency, and a live video/teleconference KYC interview with the compliance officer. Physical appearance of a director at the bank's office is not a universal statutory mandate; however, at least one signatory must execute the account mandate in front of a notary public, a Belize Consulate, or the bank's correspondent branch, and wet-ink original board resolutions are required. Banks such as Heritage Bank and Choice Bank are especially accustomed to remote onboarding for non-resident IBCs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) where nominee directors or shareholders are used.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incumbency; Register of Directors; Register of Members; Declaration of Trust and nominee agreements; legal opinion from a corporate services provider licensed by the Belize Companies Registry; sworn affidavit of UBO identity and source of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: OFAC, EU, UN, or local sanctions/PEP screening mismatch on any beneficial owner, director, or counterparty.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated sanctions screening results; professional and banking references; resumed CV of each owner/director; sworn statement explaining any name similarity; PEP status declaration and source-of-funds documentation where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for the initial capital injection into the IBC's escrow/operational account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of bank statements from the originating financial institution; board resolution authorizing capital contribution; shareholder loan agreement if structured as debt; tax assessment or dividend distribution evidence; MT103 with precise remittance info.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Organic matcha product claims without verifiable organic certification documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: USDA National Organic Program certificate; EU Organic Regulation (EU) 2018/848 certificate; Japanese JAS Organic certificate; HACCP and ISO 22000 certificates; supplier agreement and facility registration documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade invoice and shipment documentation mismatches between purchase order, proforma invoice, and bill of lading.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices; signed purchase orders; ocean or air waybill; packing list; certificate of origin; phytosanitary certificate; certificate of analysis for matcha powder; inspection reports from independent surveyors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore entity red flags under de-risking policies of correspondent banks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IBC Certificate of Incorporation and annual returns filed under Cap. 270; registered agent certificate confirming good standing; evidence that accounting records are maintained at the registered office as required by s.58 of the IBC Act; economic substance memorandum demonstrating either Belize substance or genuine offshore management.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The beneficial owner shall initiate a SWIFT MT103 wire transfer from their personal or holding-company account to the IBC's named USD account at Atlantic Bank Limited or Belize Bank Limited, using the following protocol: field 50K for the true originator; field 57A for the Belize bank's SWIFT/BIC; field 59 for the IBC account; field 70 reference 'Capital contribution to Belize IBC' with the IBC registration number; and field 23B 'CRED'. The Belize receiving bank will tag the inflow as a non-resident credit requiring no Exchange Control approval. Verification: the bank requires the IBC board resolution approving the contribution, a certificate of incumbency, and identification of the remitter; amounts above USD 10,000 equivalent trigger automatic FIU reporting and may prompt a source-of-funds questionnaire. Escrowed capital should be placed in a term deposit or clearly segregated sub-account committed to the trade program.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: SWIFT MT103 for direct telegraphic transfers to matcha powder suppliers in Japan and mainland China, with payment in JPY, CNY, or USD depending on negotiated terms. For larger or high-value consignments, the IBC may use an irrevocable, confirmed Documentary Letter of Credit issued under UCP 600 by Belize Bank or Atlantic Bank, advised through their correspondent and confirmed by a prime international bank (e.g., in Tokyo, Hong Kong, or New York). The LC flow uses MT700/MT707 for issuance and amendment and MT202 COVER for interbank reimbursement. Local BZD-denominated payments (duties, agent fees, registered-office costs) settle through the national clearing system operated by the Central Bank of Belize. All outbound trade payments require the bank to hold the underlying invoice, packing list, and evidence of the organic certification to prevent AML/CFT friction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Delivered outright FX forwards (USD/JPY and USD/CNY) with tenors up to 12 months, documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement or bank-form FX line
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on restricted or less-liquid currencies, including offshore CNY NDFs, for cross-border hedging where physical delivery is unavailable
Plain-vanilla cross-currency swaps (USD/JPY and USD/CNY) to align trade payable and receivable currency exposures
FX option strategies (call or put spread) for the IBC's anticipated matcha procurement and resale cycles, where approved by the commercial bank's market-risk committee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR), Companies Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 September of each calendar year for IBCs with authorized capital up to US$50,000; annual fee scales with authorized share capital.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% per month on unpaid fee; continued default for 3 months triggers administrative dissolution and strike-off from the Companies Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Statutory Return of Directors, Members, and Registered Office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR), Companies Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation; annual return date is the incorporation anniversary.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of US$100; persistent failure to file for 12 months may subject the IBC to strike-off proceedings by the Belize Companies Registry.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a Belize International Business Company. The IBC Act exempts qualifying IBCs from local audit and financial reporting obligations; audit is triggered only by bank financing, buyers, or voluntary shareholder resolution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bi-IFRS (Belize International Financial Reporting Standards) is not mandatory for IBC; internal accounts may be maintained under IFRS or US GAAP at management's discretion.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) details must be delivered to the licensed registered agent on or before the incorporation anniversary. Any transfer of shareholding during the year must be recorded in the Register of Members and notified to the registered agent for filing in the encrypted Belize Beneficial Ownership Register within 14 days of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$500 – US$1,500 for professional registered office and corporate secretarial agent services in Belize
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by law; voluntary independent review, if any, ranges from US$1,500 to US$5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a Belize International Business Company; domestic Belize corporate income tax headline rate is 25%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent statutory exemption under the International Business Companies Act: IBC income, profits, capital gains, dividends, interest, royalties and distributions are exempt from Belize income tax and withholding tax; no CIT advance payments or returns; no exchange-control restrictions; stamp duty exemptions apply to specified IBC instruments.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Belize IBC corporate income tax return: N/A. The exempt IBC is outside the Belize Income Tax Act; the Belize Tax Service prescribes no CIT return for IBCs. Only the registered agent's annual filing with the Belize Companies Registry and the Economic Substance return are required.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Not applicable for income tax; annual registry and economic substance filings apply
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No CIT deadline applies to a compliant exempt IBC; annual IBC renewal and Economic Substance filing deadlines are separate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No taxable income line; no CIT computation; no withholding account
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors of the IBC do not obtain a Belize tax return; the IBC should not file a Belize income tax return unless it has impermissibly transacted with Belize residents or derived Belize-source income, in which case it ceases to be a valid exempt IBC or is taxed under domestic law.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No CIT late-filing penalty can attach to an exempt IBC. Failure to renew the IBC through the registered agent, failure to pay the annual license fee, or failure to file the Economic Substance return triggers registry penalties, strike-off/deregistration, and loss of the tax exemption shield.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return and annual license renewal via a licensed Belize registered agent; Belize Companies Registry electronic system (Companies Online) or paper filing by the registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The IBC Annual Return must be filed each year; the recurrence date follows the registration anniversary and the annual renewal fee is due by each IBC's renewal cycle, usually 31 March for calendar-year renewals, subject to the Companies Registry schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of IBC and unique registry identifier
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact BZ IBC registry name; must match the Certificate of Incorporation and bank account KYC records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office maintained by a licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cannot be a PO Box; a Belize street address is required for all non-resident-owned IBCs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the Belize-licensed agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent is the mandatory local filing interface; non-resident directors cannot directly file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Share capital structure and number of issued shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If capital changes, attach board resolution; non-resident shareholding is unrestricted.
Nominee or non-resident directors are permissible only if beneficial ownership and KYC details are separately disclosed to the registered agent and the Financial Intelligence Unit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual return/renewal: late fee and loss of good standing; continued non-payment leads to strike-off from the Belize Companies Registry. Struck-off companies lose legal capacity; restoration requires court or registrar order and payment of arrears and penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return under the Belize Economic Substance Act 2019, filed by the registered agent or authorised officer through the Belize tax/registry channel designated for the IBC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 12 months after the end of the IBC's financial period, or such other period/timetable prescribed by the Belize Economic Substance Act regulations and the competent authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identify each relevant activity carried on by the IBC during the financial period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For organic matcha powder procurement and distribution, declare 'distribution and service centre' if the IBC purchases from foreign suppliers and resells to foreign buyers; a pure holding or shipping arrangement may require a different classification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Describe where and how procurement, inventory management, pricing, contracting and distribution decisions occur
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If all CIGA occur in Hong Kong or mainland China, the IBC has no Belize substance; the Economic Substance filing must reflect that fact or the company risks false declaration penalties and information exchange.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Belize address, number of local employees, and local operating expenditure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A proportionate level of local presence is required; cross-border matcha traders must maintain a real Belize office and locally based staff or risk being treated as tax resident or controlled abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue attributable to each relevant activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Segregate matcha distribution revenue from any investment income; related-party invoices must reflect arm's length prices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Board meeting location, minutes, and managers making strategic decisions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Minutes should record board meetings held in Belize; routine administrative decisions offshore do not by themselves prove tax residence, but they must not contradict the substance declared.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or false filing: monetary penalties under the Economic Substance Act, daily default fines, possible strike-off, and automatic reporting and exchange of information with treaty and tax information exchange partners. Penalties may be imposed on the IBC and, in the case of false declarations, on the directors or officers who signed.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by a Belize IBC to non-resident shareholders; Belize law imposes no dividend withholding tax on exempt IBC distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because Belize does not withhold on IBC dividends, no local DTA relief application is required for a non-resident shareholder. If the shareholder's jurisdiction taxes the Belize IBC's dividend as a foreign dividend, the shareholder must claim the treaty benefit of its own residence jurisdiction by submitting a valid tax residence certificate or TRC to that foreign tax authority. For an IBC, Belize may decline to issue a residence certificate because the company is tax-exempt and not Belize tax resident; reliance should therefore be on the local exemption rather than a Belize DTA certificate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% withholding on royalties and interest paid by an exempt Belize IBC to non-residents. Where a foreign source-country withholds on payments routed to the Belize IBC, a DTA may reduce that foreign tax only if the IBC is considered resident under the treaty; exempt IBCs typically cannot claim treaty benefits without demonstrating Belize taxation or tie-breaker residence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Belize statutory Local File or Master File threshold applies to exempt IBCs. As a best-practice safe harbour, prepare contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation when annual aggregate controlled transactions, including matcha procurement, distribution fees, management fees, and loan interest, exceed BZD 1,000,000, and always when the foreign related-entity group is subject to OECD country-by-country reporting with group revenue exceeding USD 850 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Belize Economic Substance Act 2019 applies. Cross-border procurement and resale of organic matcha powder by an IBC is classified as a 'distribution and service centre' relevant activity if the IBC purchases goods from a foreign supplier and sells them to foreign customers. The IBC must demonstrate adequate physical premises in Belize, full-time employees, local operating expenditure, local board meetings, and decision-making. A pure invoice shell or an IBC with all management in another jurisdiction fails the economic substance doctrine and faces penalties, striking-off, and exchange of information to the beneficial owner's tax administration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Use of the Belize IBC as a concealed invoice platform for organic matcha powder sales without real business purpose; filing false declarations to the Belize registered agent; understating taxable income in the shareholder's residence country; or artificially routing revenue through the IBC to avoid home-country tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal conviction for tax evasion under Belize law: substantial court-imposed fine, imprisonment, forfeiture of proceeds, and in the home jurisdiction additional understatement penalties, interest, and potential CFC or GAAR adjustments. Belize courts may also impose sanctions for false statement offences under the IBC Act and Economic Substance Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners who knowingly caused the false filings or fraudulently used the corporate form are personally liable for restitution; criminal imprisonment can be imposed, and flight risk or travel bans may be issued during tax enforcement proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining no Belize premises, no employees, no board meetings, and no operational records while invoicing large volumes of matcha trades; declaring 'no relevant activity' when the company in fact operates a distribution business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance Act penalties, daily default fines, deregistration or strike-off, freezing of bank accounts, and automatic exchange of information with the beneficial owner's residence country; the IBC loses its good-standing certificate and may be incapable of presenting valid tax residence or banking documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who signed false substance declarations are jointly and severally liable for penalties; disqualification from serving as directors, civil liability to creditors and tax authorities, and potential criminal prosecution for false statements.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to provide accurate beneficial ownership information to the registered agent; acting through undisclosed nominees; accepting or depositing trade proceeds from sanctioned suppliers; processing third-party payments without KYC; cash settlement inconsistent with the matcha trade's commercial profile.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under Belize's AML/CFT framework and Financial Intelligence Unit regulations, including monetary fines, customer due diligence non-compliance penalties, asset forfeiture, and suspension or revocation of the registered agent's licence for enabling breaches.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and beneficial owners can be held personally liable for money-laundering offences if they acted knowingly; penalties include imprisonment, civil confiscation, travel restrictions, and personal asset freezing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Cross-Border Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing intercompany matcha purchases above arm's length to strip profits from a Hong Kong or China operating entity, or receiving management fees from the Belize IBC without any services actually rendered; lacking contemporaneous benchmarking evidence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The affected foreign tax authority may recharacterize the Belize IBC as a sham, disallow deductions, impose withholding taxes on deemed dividends or royalties, assess interest and penalties up to substantial percentages of underpaid tax, and initiate mutual agreement procedure or exchange of information under the tax treaty or competent authority arrangement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who caused the mispricing in a related-party group may be liable for fraudulent conveyance or unlawful distributions; civil restitution and joint liability can be imposed, and criminal tax-fraud charges can result in imprisonment and travel bans while the foreign state enforces collection.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming Belize tax residence or a Belize TRC for the IBC when no tax is paid and no substantive management exists in Belize; failing to report the IBC to the beneficial owner's tax administration under CRS; treating the IBC as opaque while a foreign bank requires self-certification of controlling persons.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties for incorrect CRS self-certification under local law, denial of treaty benefits, retrospective application of domestic anti-avoidance rules, and compulsory exchange of information under the Belize Common Reporting Standard or AEOI framework; the IBC may also be struck off for regulatory non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Controlling persons may be personally assessed on an aggregate basis if the IBC is disregarded; deliberate CRS misrepresentation is a criminal offence in many jurisdictions, carrying fines, imprisonment, and travel bans pending extradition or mutual legal assistance.
